title: English Indices of Deprivation 2019
description: IoD2019 scores, ranks and deciles for the Index of Multiple Deprivation and each of its domains and supplementary indices, by LSOA for England, with population denominators.
publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

files.note: "File 7: all ranks, deciles and scores for the indices of deprivation, and population denominators", published 26 September 2019. 32,844 LSOAs x 57 columns. The trailing "_3" is part of the published filename, not a download suffix. Direct file: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5dc407b440f0b6379a7acc8d/File_7_-_All_IoD2019_Scores__Ranks__Deciles_and_Population_Denominators_3.csv Several column headers contain an embedded newline (e.g. "Education\n Skills and Training Score"), so they must be matched verbatim rather than by eye.
